question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
AccioJob was founded in 2018 by Vishu Bansal, Harsh Sharma, Priyanshu Agarwal and Yashwardhan Burad, four IIT Delhi alumni.\
All the founders were batchmates and friends from college since 2013.\
We were passionate about solving for employability for Indian college graduates. Spent the first couple of years iterating in this space from selling software solutions to colleges to B2B training products to reaching product market fit with B2C online and offline upskilling programs.

Before starting up, founders were active in the higher education market, speaking at events, exhibitions, conferences and guiding students making critical career decisions. Felt strongly about the problem at hand and enjoyed the journey of creating something valuable for people.

question_answers.question: What's the history of your company from getting started until the present day? What were the big inflection points?
question_answers.answer:
AccioJob was founded in 2018 by four IIT Delhi alumni and joined Y Combinator in W19 batch.

**2024 - the offline decision.** We moved from online only courses to offline centres enabling in person interaction, distraction free learning. 

**March, 2024 - first skill centre, Noida.** Learnt running an offline business. Refined pedagogies, build BTL GTM funnels, strengthened employer partnerships, made the centre run profitably in the first 8 months.

**November, 2024 - October, 2025 expansion.** Skill centres in Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, each near a live tech hiring market rather than in a metro centre for its own sake.

**Today.** Three programmes — Data Analytics with Gen AI, AI Engineering with Full Stack, and Data Science and AI — with 2,000+ students placed across 500+ hiring partners.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
India graduates over a million engineers a year, and most of them never get a fair shot at a tech job. The gap is rarely ability - it's structured practice, real feedback, and access to companies that are actually hiring.

Online courses didn't close that gap. Completion rates for self-paced programmes sit in the single digits, because a 21-year-old sitting alone with video lectures has no accountability, no peers, and nobody to ask when they're stuck at 11pm on a bug. The students who most need the training are the ones least served by a format that assumes they'll self-motivate through eight months of it.

So we built the opposite. AccioJob runs in-person skill centres where students show up daily, learn alongside a cohort, and get corrected by mentors in the room, delivering 2x better learning and placement outcomes. We then run the hiring side ourselves: 50+ hiring drives a month across 500+ partner companies, so the training connects to an actual interview rather than a certificate.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
If we succeed, where you studied stops determining whether you get a shot at a tech career.\
\
We believe strongly about the idea that employability will shift towards skills over degrees, towards capability instead of credentials. AI adoption in every domain of work will need human talent to be upskilled and reskilled. That’s the opportunity we are building for.

Every learner would think of AccioJob Skill centres as trusted institutions in their city which could help them with career guidance, personalising their roadmap, industry relevant actionable mentorship, being part of a professional community, structured upskilling programs, employment opportunities.

Concretely, that means skill centres in every Indian city with a tech hiring market, not just the four we run today, and a placement record that companies trust enough to hire from without a separate screening round.

name: Codingal
long_description:
Codingal (www.codingal.com) is the global leader in online AI and coding education for kids and teens (Grades 1-12). Our mission is to help students fall in love with AI & coding and become creators of the future - entrepreneurs, engineers, and scientists by providing high-quality, accessible, and personalized computer science education.

In many countries, top technical universities exist, but there’s a significant gap in K-12 programming education. Parents want their kids to start learning programming early, and that’s why they choose Codingal. We offer live, interactive classes with expert instructors from Computer Science backgrounds. All our instructors are rigorously vetted and trained to ensure a high-quality learning experience.

Every student receives a personalized learning path tailored to their age and skill level. Our curriculum is STEM.org-accredited, aligned with the K–12 Computer Science Framework, and delivered in 1:1 and small-group formats, ensuring individual attention and engagement.

Students learn by building real-world projects using popular tools and technologies like Scratch, Python, Roblox, Minecraft, MIT App Inventor, Thunkable, Pygame, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, website development, Java, Data Science, AP Computer Science content, and AI tools like ChatGPT and Machine Learning frameworks. Through this hands-on approach, students create apps, games, animations, and websites in a fun, engaging way that fosters problem-solving and creative skills.

Beyond classes, students participate in global coding competitions, hackathons like HPE CodeWars, and online coding camps, further nurturing their creativity, confidence, and innovative spirit. With a 4.9/5 student rating and NPS of 86, Codingal is trusted by over 1 million registered students in 70+ countries.

Codingal combines the best of human instruction and AI-driven learning to inspire the next generation of tech leaders. We are poised to lead the next generation of coding education and make a significant impact in this rapidly growing market.
one_liner: Leading online after-school for kids & teens to learn AI & coding

launches.title: SuperKalam: AI-Powered Learning, Human-Driven Success
launches.tagline: Solving the challenges of affordability and accessibility to great teachers in India
launches.body:
In India, more than 5 million students set their sights on top careers in Engineering, Medicine, and Civil Services each year. However, they face significant hurdles in finding great mentors and teachers. [SuperKalam](https://superkalam.com/), a revolutionary AI-backed education initiative, comes to the rescue, empowering students with access to personalized mentorship in a discipline-inculcating learning ecosystem.

> SuperKalam prepares study plans and sets daily targets based on a student's progress, keeping track of common mistakes, performance and time spent on specific concepts or subjects. This innovative approach is already working wonders, and the aim is to scale this to reach 5 million students in India, starting with the Indian Civil Services Examination (UPSC).

Read on to discover the magical superpowers of SuperKalam!

[Vimal](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vimalsinghrathore/), alongside [Aseem](https://www.linkedin.com/in/-aseemgupta/), is the driving force behind building superkalam.com

Vimal, one of India’s top educators for more than 7 years, has witnessed the rise of edtech from the unique perspective of both founder and teacher during his tenure at unacademy and subsequently while building out his first startup in education, [coursavy (acquired by unacademy)](https://inc42.com/buzz/edtech-unicorn-unacademy-acquires-upsc-test-prep-platform-coursavy/)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73599&key=user_uploads/990441/aa5fca7e-ed8d-4ee3-9485-5a3f8b486782)

Current Edtech solutions primarily involve one-way content delivery, where thousands of students merely consume the content without engaging in effective discussions with the teacher. This leads to a loss of curiosity and, eventually, to poor learning outcomes. Furthermore, an excess of content leads to a multitude of choices, often resulting in confusion and chaotic, unplanned preparation.

**SuperKalam steps in to solve these issues with simplicity and focus.** Vimal has championed this process through his education initiatives over the past decade. Now, leveraging the latest AI technology, SuperKalam is fully equipped to scale founder’s counter-intuitive insights and learnings to assist millions of students in India, starting with the UPSC exam.

### **Solution**

Wondering about the superpowers of SuperKalam? Let's uncover the magic.

It assists in creating a **personalised timetable**, sending **daily targets**, and tracking progress throughout the learning journey.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73599&key=user_uploads/990441/42988042-7dd4-41a8-854a-36180d858340)

It helps resolve doubts, aids in mastering concepts, and can **evaluate** a UPSC student’s handwritten answer in less than 60 seconds — a process that typically takes 2-4 weeks in the current education market.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73599&key=user_uploads/990441/bb9f8270-0139-4d0a-9f06-e9f5a506b94c)

It conducts **mock tests**, identifies students' strengths and weaknesses, and provides **progress reports** that foster self-awareness, unlocking their full potential.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73599&key=user_uploads/990441/8b7f2fdc-f768-407c-8266-ae3bf70607ff)

Do share your experience or feedback with us at [vimal@kalam.in](mailto:vimal@kalam.in)

Social Media Pages:

[Youtube](https://www.youtube.com/@superkalam_?sub_confirmation=1)  |  [Twitter](https://twitter.com/SuperKalam_)  \
\
**Thankyou!**

launches.body:
**tl;dr:** qoohoo helps creators to grow, manage and monetise their audience across all platforms. Creators on qoohoo earn swiftly from their micro-content, courses & subscriptions directly on Whatsapp and Telegram unlocking massive growth potential. **Check out our** [**product**](https://qoohoo.in/)**.**

Hello everyone, we are [Aseem](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/594687) & [Vimal](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/990441), the team behind [qoohoo](https://qoohoo.in/).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69590&key=user_uploads/990441/0058114c-2b3e-4ddd-aeee-90f327d47b20)

### **Problem**

Communities on Telegram and WhatsApp have been growing at a rapid pace, especially in the last few years. Creators tend to bring their audience from social media to messaging apps, but they don't have a way to monetize or manage them effectively. 

They are currently managing their backend operations in a chaotic, error-prone, and time-consuming way, manually handling payments and adding/removing users separately.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69590&key=user_uploads/990441/010078e6-3abc-4907-9a23-f8702f004f53)

Besides monetisation, creators need help with _audience growth, retention_, and _reactivation_. **They are missing critical audience insights, behaviour and nudges to grow their business effectively to their full potential.**

This problem was first faced by Vimal while running his edtech startup - coursavy, where communities of students & LIVE courses were the core. He used to create a telegram channel for each course and manually managed the operations. His brother is also a [_YouTuber in music learning_](https://www.youtube.com/@MusicwaleLessons/featured) facing similar issues while running classes on Whatsapp.

This experience gave us a ring-side view of the problem and the scale.

### **Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69590&key=user_uploads/990441/92fd5d84-0568-4e39-a74a-0af7b6787233)

Creators on qoohoo can quickly launch their micro-content, courses & subscriptions directly on Whatsapp and Telegram unlocking massive growth potential.

If we take simplicity & speed into account, _what whatsapp is for personal communication, qoohoo is for creators. It’s that simple!_

In February alone, our creators are earning close to **$500K** in the field of Art, Music, Education and Finance.

_One of our_ creators’ earnings has surged from **$10K** to **$125K** per month in just 10 months of using our product. She leverages YouTube for distribution and qoohoo for monetization.

### **Ask & Deal**

Today we are launching our global version, now anyone across any nation can use qoohoo easily. This is a beta release, we will keep on adding all the new tools going forward.

**Check out our product** at <https://qoohoo.in/>

* It will be super nice if you could use our product & share your experience, we are available at [founders@qoohoo.in](mailto:founders@qoohoo.in)
* If you have creators or startups in your circle who are running their communities & courses, do connect us with them. (We have special offers for YC companies & referrals :)

Let's keep building and moving forward! Thanks for your support. 🙏

launches.tagline: Snap, ask, and learn anything with Studdy Buddy
launches.body:
### TL;DR

Have you ever been studying something and **wished you could instantly ask a question** about it to an expert? Now you can, with Studdy.

[Studdy](https://studdy.ai/) is an AI tutor for students. Anytime you need help with schoolwork (or any material you’re reading), **just snap a picture to get instant help from Studdy Buddy**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73856&key=user_uploads/1332645/ee2a0350-1b1c-4d20-aa05-b79c3254dfb0)

### The problem

Students are not getting the help they need to succeed in school. Every year, [**65%+ of all U.S. eighth graders**](https://www.nytimes.com/2022/10/24/us/math-reading-scores-pandemic.html) score **“below proficient,” in reading comprehension and math.**

The problem is that **class sizes are too large** for teachers to provide enough 1:1 help to every kid. Districts can’t afford to hire more teachers, and parents are unable to help their kids at home because they don’t know the material either.

When a student falls behind for just a couple of weeks, it can lead to a spiral of underachievement that ultimately leads to many kids giving up. Studdy is here to stop the spiral.

### How Studdy Helps

When students need extra help understanding material from class, **Studdy is available 24/7 to answer any questions and patiently explain any concepts**. Studdy never gets angry, impatient, or tired - and it loves answering follow up questions.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73856&key=user_uploads/1332645/bcb4d350-5c3e-474d-8a0e-ef6cf0ab1489)

Things Studdy can do:

* **Break problems down** into simple steps
* Answer **unlimited follow up questions**
* **Summarize** pages for you
* **Test** your reading comprehension
* Quiz you to make sure you **understand the “why”** of what you’re doing and aren’t just regurgitating homework steps
* Frame problems and **draw relationships** for you
* Speak to you at your grade level, **in your own language**
* Plus more!

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73856&key=user_uploads/1332645/bbb5e47e-6f23-4512-8723-d0fedc547559)


### Studdy vs ChatGPT

Studdy is purpose built for students:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73856&key=user_uploads/1332645/ef16271e-a1eb-4ed5-9b53-49a9c4756cca)

### Our Story

Alex and I built Studdy for our former selves (we were not good students back in the day). Too much lecturing would put us to sleep, and that caused issues when it came time to do homework.

We wished we had a tutor available 24/7 who could answer all of our questions at home - when we would try to catch up on the material we’d missed during class.

Alex dropped out of college at 19 and he’s been plotting how to reform education ever since. I spent the last four years working in ed-tech and AI at Photomath, and then [@Speak](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/1443) (W17), where I helped build an AI language tutor on GPT3 & 4. Alex and I previously worked together [@Starcity](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/1431) (S16) before creating Studdy.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73856&key=user_uploads/1332645/c0dabeee-b4bf-4ddd-86c1-09d47515fe9b)

### Our Ask

* **Try** **our** [iOS App](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/studdy-ai-pocket-tutor/id6450114499)!
* **Share this post!** Send it to students, parents, teachers, friends.
* If you know **any professors** who might want to **partner up on** **AI-Education Research**, we’d love to chat.
* Shoot us a note at [**team@studdy.ai**](mailto:team@studdy.ai) if you’d like to help us
* Leave us a kind review on the app store : )

question_answers.answer: **Educato builds exam prep platforms worldwide using AI.**Online exam prep has existed for decades, yet the big players all target the same top 10 exams in the US. The reality is that most exams around the world still have little to no quality online prep material, including many taken by hundreds of thousands of students each year. Educato uses AI to generate high-quality prep content for these exams.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: The state of education is not a natural state of the world, but a set of technological tools to best teach students. Classrooms with teachers came about in the 17th century as Europe aimed to democratise education. Exams are tools that aim find the correlation between your score and how good you'll be at a particular job, for example being a doctor or an engineer. Multiple-choice questions were invented in the early 20th century to allow objective grading at scale.AI advancements allow us to better educate and evaluate students.Right now, most exams are multiple-choice, but , we expect to see more sophisticated grading systems using AI, including more essays and interviews. For instance, testing future doctors will still require knowledge-based exams, but we’ll also need to assess qualities like empathy and decision making. We see Educato as a leader in not only providing solid prep for current exams but also adapting to these future, AI-enhanced evaluations.

launches.title: SimCare AI – Scaling Healthcare Training and Evaluation with AI Patients & Simulations
launches.tagline: Conversations with AI patients to scale clinical training.
launches.body:
Hi everyone, we’re [Vrishank](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vrishanksaini/) and [Tigran](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/soma-lab)[,](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2094245) the team behind [SimCare AI](https://somalab.ai)**.**

**tl;dr:** SimCare AI (prev. “Soma Lab”) creates AI-simulated conversations to scale healthcare training. Students and providers practice with our AI patients to build skills and get evaluated.

**The Problem: Healthcare Training and Evaluation Isn’t Scalable**

Healthcare still relies on slow, expensive methods like role-playing, in-person evaluations, and one-on-one interviews. These outdated approaches not only create bottlenecks in education and hiring but also cost institutions hundreds of thousands of dollars annually in faculty time, actor fees, and administrative overhead. Scaling these processes is critical, but traditional methods make it nearly impossible.

While governments and accrediting bodies are pushing to expand healthcare workforces by increasing the number of schools and seats, the real bottleneck lies in non-didactic training. Schools have figured out how to scale lectures and coursework online, but they can’t scale the hands-on, interactive training required to meet competency-based accreditation standards like CACREP.

Adding to the challenge, **it is illegal to practice counseling without direct clinical supervision** in the classroom or the proper licenses. Students can’t even practice these conversations with friends or family legally, which leaves schools dependent on expensive, resource-intensive methods like faculty supervised role-playing.

# **The Solution: AI-Simulated Conversations at Scale**

SimCare AI uses AI to create realistic, interactive conversations with patients that allow students and professionals to practice and be evaluated anytime, anywhere. Our simulations replace costly methods with scalable alternatives, saving institutions significant time and money. Our system provides a legal, scalable solution for hands-on training, enabling schools to bypass these restrictions, meet accreditation requirements, and expand rapidly without sacrificing quality.

Therapy programs use SimCare AI to train students with AI patients, reducing reliance on actors. Companies use AI patients to assess job applicants and onboard new hires efficiently. Medical and social work programs prepare learners for real-world challenges without the need for resource-heavy manual evaluations.

In just **3 weeks**, we were able to close **30 pilots** with institutions like the University of Pennsylvania, Virginia Tech, University of Sydney, John Carroll University, and Western Carolina University.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85622&key=user_uploads/1053982/effe8dfb-c4cb-4b32-b0d5-03dee23e2036)

### For example:

* **Therapy and counseling schools** use SimCare AI to replace role-playing exercises with our AI patients that simulate realistic therapy sessions. Students can practice conversations anytime and get evaluated instantly, helping programs scale without relying on limited and expensive faculty or actors.
* **Teletherapy companies** use SimCare AI to screen job applicants by testing their skills with AI patients, ensuring quality candidates are hired faster and cost-effectively. They also use SimCare AI for internal training to ensure company standards.
* **Social work programs** use SimCare AI to train students with AI families and patients, evaluate them on critical interactions, and provide targeted remediation when needed.
* **Medical schools** use SimCare AI to teach students how to handle patient interactions before they see real patients.

# **The Team**

We met at the University of Chicago after joining the same fraternity. Vrishank failed a clinical communications test and couldn’t afford the $9,000 tutor fee. So instead, we built an AI clinical communications coach. Vrishank's score shot up, so we said screw it and launched the tool. In 3 weeks, we hit $5k MRR and 2.5k users. Seeing the impact this would have if applied to all of healthcare, we decided to build the AI infrastructure for healthcare training and evaluation.

While in high school, Vrishank created a healthcare education app, which scaled to 120,000+ downloads in 6 months. Tigran was the lead machine learning researcher in a bioinformatics lab at the Luddy School of Informatics.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85622&key=user_uploads/1053982/5aa3f430-08fd-4595-bf57-4c917a6d8252)

# **How You Can Help**

Share this with anyone in healthcare or education who trains, hires, or evaluates students and professionals.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85622&key=user_uploads/1053982/43d2a87d-4ea5-4ecd-ad02-0f199ed84104)

launches.body:
Hi everyone! We are [Guang](https://www.linkedin.com/in/guang-cui/) and [Tyrone](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tyroned3/) - cofounders of Miyagi Labs.

**TL;DR**

We use AI to transform YouTube content into complete, interactive courses—imagine a 3Blue1Brown video turned into an online course with quizzes and study material. We help people learn better with active practice and personalized feedback.

[Demo video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-8AfVemdtr0)

**The Problem**

Learning is flawed: online resources are everywhere, but 1-1 tutoring (which most people can’t afford) is still 2 standard deviations more effective than other methods. 

YouTube has top-notch content on everything for free, but how do you turn that passive watching into active learning?

**Our Solution**

Content creators, educators, and learners can instantly convert educational videos into structured, interactive courses that drive real learning.

Our [platform](https://miyagilabs.ai/) automatically generates short-answer and multiple-choice questions, quizzes, and AI-driven feedback, turning passive watching into an active, engaging experience. Learners receive instant responses to their answers and can access an AI voice tutor for additional guidance.

Creators and educators, who love sharing knowledge but don’t have time to create entire courses, can focus on what they do best while we handle the active learning and engagement.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXd_zOqR1Y2oqnOjlrJ5PjjmfRbYTBbY-iXt5YHOD7JgVvrvtYAMp-5ydGudljDOetpB5lxXpzZ9cLZR-7BFYogL-UY91D-SwsyByTND5ge_amUhxg1z36k3CzMHUdiEPwDI2ySMUQ?key=JK8gbU_5XOAH5k3bm1TXYGo-)

**The Team**

Guang and Tyrone met in college at MIT studying Computer Science and both are extremely passionate about learning and teaching.

Tyrone became a chess master in 4 years just from watching YouTube, has learned 4 languages, and has taught computer science around the world.

Guang has taught algorithms (as a TA), math, physics, and music to hundreds of students. He has also become an elite American Ninja Warrior and coached students at multiple gyms. 

Because of our experiences, we have unique insights on how to learn and teach effectively.

launches.tagline: The Booth Brothers are building an iPad app that understands math as it's written
launches.body:
Hey there 👋

We’re [James](https://x.com/J4mesBooth) and [Max](https://x.com/MaxB00th) - brothers and cofounders of [Chiron](https://projectchiron.org).

# 📌 **TL;DR**

Chiron is an [iPad app](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/project-chiron/id6502346822) that understands math as it’s written - like Grammarly for algebra. We’re both Oxford math grads, have tutored for a decade, and we’re creating the future of learning which will be entirely 1-on-1.

[Launch Video](https://youtu.be/Ec8Nwe0EaSU)

# ❌ **Problem**

With AI that’s so great at math, why can’t it teach at near-human quality?

* Math is handwritten ✏️
* Math has to be practiced not read 🧮
* AI is rubbish at spotting _your_ mistakes 🔍

# ✅ **Solution**

* Freeform writing on a whiteboard app ✍️
* Accuracy of a calculator with symbolic logic 🔢
* Real-time feedback on every stroke (< 300ms) ⚡

# ⚙️ **How we do it?**

With tens of thousands of lines of Python and Wolfram Language code. Writing on an iPad, we convert the stroke data to LaTeX, parse it, ask a million symbolic questions about it with reference to the problem’s _ground truth_ (the lines with a blue index), and assess whether it is right, wrong or something in between.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90706&key=user_uploads/1522067/b06893f5-bab0-4021-b09e-c8d38b33e4ee)

We do **not** rely on the vibes of a language model to assess the details of their working - too slow and unreliable. Many students give up on LLMs for genuine collaboration when they mislead them on topics the student finds difficult.

**We can handle a lot of math already.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90706&key=user_uploads/1522067/df464a12-f051-4c0a-8c03-90e660079c40)

# **💡 Core insight**

We tried all the AI tutor desktop formulations we could imagine, but beyond the obvious interface challenge, AI is exceptionally poor at spotting the subtle mistakes students often make. LLMs are great at doing correct math, but much worse at pulling out an error within the many lines of messy student reasoning.

We started performing a symbolic analysis of the student’s working as context for the AI to boost accuracy - **but then we realised we could give this straight to the student.** This was when we started to feel the magic.

# **🙏 Our Ask**

So far, _every_ single teacher we’ve demoed our iPad app to in person has immediately started work greenlighting a pilot. Let us know if you can introduce us to any math teachers teaching between Algebra I and Calculus I.

And you can check out Chiron on the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/project-chiron/id6502346822) now - or share with any students who might benefit from it!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90706&key=user_uploads/1522067/7b18b9c0-1e00-49fa-a8bb-d6ab7bb7d080)

Cheers, James & Max
